_readme: Attack ranges as tiles, because the wiki only documents them as in-game screenshots.
Each entry is a list of [column, row] offsets from the tile the Tatari stands on.
Column is positive to the right. Row is NEGATIVE towards the Zobos, because row 1
is the contact line at the top of the field and row 6 is nearest your base.
So [0, 0] is the Tatari's own tile, [0, -1] is one tile ahead of it, and
[-1, -2] is two ahead and one to the left.
Ranges are shared across an evolution line unless an entry says otherwise, the
same way the Horde level-up skills are — so key these by the line's base form
where you can, and by an individual slug only when that form differs.
To add one: open the Tatari in the app, read the attack-range diagram in its
detail sheet (the Tatari stands at the bottom, lit tiles are what it reaches),
and write the offsets here. Set "checked" to the name of whoever confirmed it
in game, or leave it out if it is only read off the diagram.
Anything not listed here simply shows no range, rather than a guess.

rubblet.note: a 3-wide block around itself, plus one tile further ahead
